Unified context-window meter. Renders as a compact progress `bar` or a circular `gauge`; hovering or focusing it opens a popover with the model, the context-window breakdown, per-bucket token usage and the cost + budget detail. Domain-agnostic — callers feed plain numbers.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/ContextMeter.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { ContextMeter } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
